notes.title: 🔴 Live: Volleying Together
notes.content:
I will be available to chat with you, answer to your questions and listen to your suggestions while playing Volleying. By the way, have you heard that my games are completely made using only free tools (open-source)? Come check out this and much more!

Thanks for your support!
Take care!
André Nardelli

notes.title: Soccering is 50% off!
notes.content:
Soccering is the younger sibling of Volleying. It's another physics based game; played with spheres; up to 4 players; with co-op mode, and online playable through "Steam Remote Play Together"...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1012530/Soccering

I hope you enjoy it as well!
Thanks for your support!
Take care,
André Nardelli

notes.title: Volleying freely playable for 2 weeks - Please, stay at home!
notes.content:
Guys, due to quarantine I decided to keep Volleying freely playable for 2 weeks, starting today. Also, during the same period, it will be available to purchase for the lowest price ever. I hope you enjoy it!

And please, stay at home as much as you can!

Thanks for your support!
Take care,
André Nardelli

notes.title: Change in the Keyboard Controls mapping!
notes.content:
Hello Guys,

I've listened to you and I've changed the mapping of keyboard controls to please the majority of the players - that are used to playing with the WASD system.

From now on:

[list]
[*] Keyboard Mode 1 = WASD + Space (Default)
[*] Keyboard Mode 2 = Arrows + Enter (KeyPad Enter as well)
[/list]

Thanks for your support!
GDS

notes.title: Volleying - Original SoundTrack available!
notes.content:
Do you like the [b]Volleying Soundtrack[/b]? Now you can purchase the [b]OST[/b] as a [b]DLC[/b] content!

Enjoy it!
Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Volleying Released - 30% off!
notes.content:
This last Early Access update brings 4 new achievements and 2 new songs (Press the square brackets to navigate between tracks). Enjoy it!

Even with the end of EA, please fell free to continue sharing your ideas and suggestions, so we can keep improving the game together!

Thank you all for supporting Volleying!

notes.title: How to customize Players and Courts?
notes.content:
[b]Volleying[/b] allows you to customize the Players and Curts [b]skins[/b]. The instructions for this are following: 
[olist]
[*][b]Open the Steam Client > Right click on Volleying > Properties > Local Files > BROWSE LOCAL FILES[/b]
[*]Look inside the [b]"conf"[/b] directory. There are the template files (.png) for Players and Courts, as well the instructions of how to save the images... Pick your favorite image editor, create your images and play with your own artwork. 
[/olist]
Please feel free to share your images at [b]Artwork[/b] tab in the [b]Volleying Community[/b]

Thanks for the support!
